games.name: Fan Duel
games.description:
Fan Duel is a thrilling arcade puzzle experience that combines strategy, speed, and quick decision making into one intense gameplay loop. In Fan Duel, you must navigate a compact 9 by 9 maze and reach the glowing exit before time runs out. Every round in Fan Duel presents a newly generated layout, ensuring that each attempt feels fresh, unpredictable, and engaging.

The core challenge of Fan Duel lies not only in finding the correct path but also in avoiding a relentless red pursuer that moves after every step you take. This mechanic transforms Fan Duel into a tense chase where every move matters. The further you progress, the faster the pursuer becomes, forcing you to think ahead and act quickly to survive.

Fan Duel is designed to reward both speed and smart planning. Reaching the exit quickly grants time bonuses, allowing you to build a higher score and extend your run. At the same time, Fan Duel encourages careful movement, as reckless decisions can lead you straight into danger. Balancing risk and reward is the key to mastering Fan Duel.

You start each session in Fan Duel with three hearts, giving you limited chances to make mistakes. Losing all hearts ends your run, so every step should be calculated. This adds an extra layer of tension to Fan Duel, making each round feel meaningful and exciting. The more efficiently you move and escape, the longer you stay in the game.

One of the most engaging aspects of Fan Duel is its procedural maze generation. Every maze is guaranteed to have a valid path, but the layout constantly changes, ensuring that players cannot rely on memorization. This makes Fan Duel highly replayable and keeps the experience fresh no matter how many times you play.

Fan Duel also emphasizes progression and self improvement. With each completed round, the difficulty gradually increases, testing your reflexes and decision making skills. The game motivates players to beat their personal best and discover how many rounds they can survive in Fan Duel.

The controls in Fan Duel are simple and intuitive, allowing players to focus entirely on movement and strategy. Whether you prefer quick taps or more deliberate actions, Fan Duel adapts to your playstyle and keeps the gameplay smooth and responsive.

With its minimalist design, dynamic pacing, and constant tension, Fan Duel delivers an addictive experience that is easy to pick up but difficult to master. Every round feels like a new challenge, and every escape brings a sense of accomplishment.

Each level in Lost Puzzles of Egypt is randomly generated, so each new game offers a unique combination of numbers and tile layouts. The player must carefully analyze the board and choose which tiles to hide under the sand to comply with all the rules.

The time limit for solving the puzzle is limited. If the player manages to restore the harmony of the numbers, they receive a reward and can move on to the next challenge. If the time runs out early, the round ends and the player can try again.

Lost Puzzles of Egypt also offers bonus events. The player can experience the blessing of Ra—a special moment when the ancient god appears on the screen, and quick taps can earn extra coins and rare rewards.

Callbreak (also known as Lakadi or Lakdi) is a popular trick-based card game widely played in Nepal and India. It uses a standard 52-card deck and is played among four players, where each player receives 13 cards.

games.name: 5D Chess
games.description:
5D Chess reimagines the classic game of chess by introducing time travel and parallel timelines as core gameplay mechanics. Instead of playing on a single board with a linear sequence of moves, players compete across multiple boards that exist at different moments in time and across alternate realities. The result is a strategic experience that goes far beyond traditional chess.

At its foundation, the game still follows the familiar rules of chess. Pieces move in the same ways they always have: bishops diagonally, rooks along ranks and files, knights in L-shaped jumps, and so on. However, players are no longer restricted to moving pieces only within the present moment of a single board. Pieces can travel backward or forward through time, interact with earlier positions, and even create entirely new timelines.

When a piece moves into the past, it creates a branching timeline that develops independently from the original board. This produces multiple parallel versions of the game that exist simultaneously. Each timeline evolves based on the moves played within it, allowing the game to expand dynamically as new timelines are created. Players must think not only about space on a chessboard but also about how their moves affect the structure of time itself.

The interface organizes boards along a visual timeline so players can clearly track how events unfold across dimensions. Each board represents a specific point in time within a particular timeline. As the game progresses, additional boards appear, forming a network of interconnected realities. Players must monitor threats, defenses, and opportunities across these timelines simultaneously.

Because of this structure, strategy becomes dramatically more complex. A move made in the present might be countered by sending a piece into the past to alter the position before that move ever happened. Alternatively, players can create new timelines to escape dangerous situations or launch attacks that originate from different moments in time. Planning several moves ahead now involves understanding how multiple timelines may evolve in parallel.

Victory is still achieved through checkmate, but the concept expands significantly. Your king must remain safe across all active timelines while you attempt to trap your opponent’s king somewhere within the multiverse. This means that defensive play requires managing threats across many boards at once, while offensive strategies may involve coordinating attacks that originate from different timelines.

The result is a game that rewards deep planning, pattern recognition, and creative problem solving. Players who enjoy complex strategy games will find that 5D Chess offers a unique challenge that continually evolves as new timelines appear.

Features include:

Traditional chess mechanics combined with time-travel gameplay
Parallel timelines that branch when pieces move into the past
Multiple boards representing different moments in time
A clear timeline visualization system for tracking alternate realities
Complex strategic interactions across timelines and boards
Matches that evolve dynamically as new timelines form
A challenging experience for players who enjoy deep strategic thinking

Every match of 5D Chess becomes its own multiverse puzzle. Instead of calculating moves only along a single board, players must understand how their actions ripple through time and across alternate realities. A single decision can create new possibilities, new threats, and entirely new timelines that reshape the game.

Whether you are a long-time chess player or someone interested in unusual strategy games, 5D Chess offers a distinctive experience that expands the boundaries of what chess can be. Play chess across time and parallel timelines in the multiverse

games.description:
知らなかった世界に出会える、知識カードコレクションゲーム。

WikiGachaは、オンライン百科事典のランダムな記事をカードに変換するガチャゲームです。パックを開封すると、さまざまなジャンルの記事が6段階のレアリティ（C〜LR）のカードとして登場。記事の内容に基づいてATK・DEFが決まるユニークなカードを集めて、自分だけのコレクションを作りましょう。

■ ガチャで知識と出会う
毎日届くパックを開けて、新しいカードをゲット。10回に1回は高レアリティ確定の金パックが出現します。

■ コレクションを充実させよう
集めたカードは図鑑に保存。レアリティでフィルターして、お気に入りのカードを見つけましょう。気になる記事はそのままブラウザで読むことができます。

■ カードバトルで腕試し
コレクションからカードを選んでオートバトル。ATKとDEFの合計値で勝敗が決まります。

■ デイリーミッション
毎日5つのミッションをクリアして、追加パックを獲得。遊ぶほどコレクションが広がります。
